thread:
mike: quick ping — PR #8567 (cache eviction optimization) is blocked by CI. failing test is tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::test_retrieve_after_eviction. It fails nondeterministically on CI only. need to land this before EOW, can someone take a look? :pray:

ci-bot: CI pipeline failed on job `integration-linux-qt`. Summary:
```
FAILED tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::test_retrieve_after_eviction - AssertionError: expected value 'x' but got None
TimeoutError: Operation timed out after 3000ms
```

jen: on it. can you paste the commit SHA? I can try to reproduce locally with the same env.

mike: sha: 4f9c2b7 — same docker image as CI: redwood/py-integration:2026-03-16-rc2. The failure rate on CI is ~1/12 runs. No failures on my laptop so far.

jen: ok starting a local run against the integration image. ping me if there's a repro log link.

alex: quick glance at the diff — we bumped the continuous-batch window to 8ms in this PR. That could increase racey eviction timing when combined with the TTL cleanup thread. Worth trying to revert that change as a test.

mike: interesting. I can try a revert branch and trigger CI. Would that be a fast unblock?

jen: also see this log snippet in CI artifacts:
```
[ worker-7 ] evicting key=abc123 ts=1617281234
[ worker-7 ] retrieve key=abc123 -> None
AssertionError: expected 'payload' but got None
```
That looks like the eviction and retrieve are happening almost simultaneously.

sara: if this is a timing window, we could mark the test flaky for now and add a follow-up to harden the KV semantics. but prefer to land a fix if simple. marking flaky will unblock, but we should attach an eval ticket.

alex: agree with sara. If mike can try the revert of the batch window and CI goes green, we'll push that and follow up with a proper fix (lock or atomic check).

mike: created revert branch: 4f9c2b7-revert-batch-window and pushed. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/48291. cc @jen for local confirmation.

jen: queued a local run and also kicked CI rerun.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by jen. Job queued: integration-linux-qt (#48292).

jen: my local run still sporadic but I saw the test pass 5/5 after revert. fingers crossed for CI. :crossed_fingers:

ci-bot: Job integration-linux-qt (#48292) completed — status: FAILED. failing test: test_retrieve_after_eviction. artifact: https://ci.redwood.example/artifacts/48292/log.txt

alex: hmm CI still failed. can you attach the full failing trace from the artifact, jen? maybe the revert wasn't complete (there's a cache layer that keeps the window config).

jen: pasting relevant tail from artifact:
```
2026-03-16T14:12:02Z [evict-thread] window_ms=8
2026-03-16T14:12:02Z [worker-4] delete key=abc123
2026-03-16T14:12:02Z [worker-4] retrieve key=abc123 -> None
```
so the env still shows window_ms=8. looks like the revert branch didn't pick up the config baked into the integration image.

mike: ah — right. the integration image tag we used still has the bumped config. I'll trigger a new image build with revert and re-run CI.

sara: if image rebuild will take too long, let's mark the test flaky temporarily so we can merge other dependent PRs. but prefer to avoid skipping long-term.

mike: going to build image now. ETA ~15m. anyone opposed to blocking this PR until we confirm CI green?

alex: block is fine. don't want to merge something that could break prod.

jen: i'll keep an eye. if you want a temp bypass, we can add @pytest.mark.flaky on that test and remove after root cause. but put a TODO and link an issue.

mike: decided: hold merge, I will rebuild the integration image with the revert, re-run CI, and if it still flakes we'll mark flaky and file a follow-up issue to harden KV eviction semantics. will post updates here.

(15m later)

ci-bot: New image `redwood/py-integration:2026-03-16-revert-4f9c2b7` pushed. Job integration-linux-qt (#48298) queued.

ci-bot: Job integration-linux-qt (#48298) completed — status: PASSED. All tests green.

jen: confirmed: local + CI green on the revert image. :tada:

alex: awesome. mike, please open a follow-up ticket to add stronger KV eviction guarantees and include a regression test.

mike: filed RW-1428: "kv cache: race during eviction/retrieve — harden semantics" and linked it in the PR description. merging now. thanks for the quick help everyone! :rocket:

sara: thanks all — good call to keep this gated.

mike: merged and cutting a small release candidate. thanks! :shipit:
